title: Message Queues and Async Tasks
description: Decouple heavy API operations with Redis and Celery in your company monorepo: add Redis and Flower to Docker Compose, configure Celery with retries and exponential backoff, convert the slowest endpoint to async (202 + task_id), implement GET /tasks/{task_id}, record failed tasks in a Dead Letter Queue after max_retries, run workers as separate processes, and monitor with Flower.
